prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: TICO Egyptian bakery production composition guide, widescreen 16:9 1600x900. Primary request: polished hand-painted illustrated 2D SIDE-ON cutaway of an ordinary contemporary Egyptian neighborhood baladi bread bakery. Orthographic side-scroller camera, not isometric, not overhead. Warm cream plaster, dusty turquoise trim, restrained terracotta and saffron accents, clean confident contours, sophisticated cozy game art rather than childish clipart. Layout: entire left 40 percent is an open bakery alcove with an arched brick oven at x160 y425, Hassan the moustached Egyptian baker in cream shirt terracotta apron at x350 with feet y690, and a small wooden service counter x400 y570 through x560 y710. Above that alcove a teal and cream striped awning at y240. Empty matte sandstone wall to the right with high teal shutters, subtle laundry and electric meter suggesting modern Cairo. Lower 35 percent broad continuous sandy paved sidewalk, flat horizontal walking ground at y735. Eight distinct ordinary Egyptian adult customers in modest varied contemporary everyday clothing wait facing LEFT in a straight line from x670 to x1460, spaced evenly, feet all y735, height about200px. First woman sand hijab teal dress, next curly-haired young man teal overshirt terracotta backpack. No queue railings whatsoever. Spacious clear forecourt at lower left to exit. Olive tree and clay planters only at far edges, never across queue. Baker should be about same height as customers. Decorative sign blank, NO text, no lettering, no logos, no UI. All characters naturally in left-facing side profile; baker faces right toward customers. Counter does not extend beneath all the queue. Include warm oven light and a few round Egyptian baladi loaves on a tray only at counter. This is a layout guide for separately animated sprites, coherent continuous architectural geometry, no broken fences or impossible roads. Composition must feel like a real lovingly crafted 2D management game.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: empty environment base layer for TICO side-on 2D bakery game. Input image is the approved composition guide. Preserve the EXACT canvas framing, orthographic camera, wall geometry, shutter positions, pavement, colors and painterly finish. Remove ALL nine people including baker and remove all bread, the wooden serving counter, oven masonry and fire, the entire striped awning, the tree and every foreground potted plant. Fill their silhouettes naturally with continuing wall, empty dark bakery interior and floor. Left bakery opening stays an EMPTY open alcove with a plain dark warm plaster back wall, small lamp and tiled bottom half, no shelves, no bread, no tools. Preserve opening columns and lintel, blank teal sign, shutters, laundry and meter. Foreground is a continuous empty sandstone sidewalk. Do not add replacement objects, shadows of removed objects, queue markings, rails, people, bread, text or UI. This is only the fixed wall/interior/pavement layer; removed oven/counter/awning/actors will be composited independently by the browser.
